description: This PHP source file defines the Total controller class within the Opencart admin extension namespace. It manages listing, installation, and uninstallation of total-type extensions, including loading related resources, handling user permissions, and rendering views.

classes.name: Total
classes.description: Controller class for managing 'Total' extensions in the Opencart admin panel, including listing available extensions, and performing install/uninstall operations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the list of Total extensions by calling getList and outputs the view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Loads language, reads available extension files, retrieves installed extensions, filters, and prepares data for the total extensions list view.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles installation of a Total extension, including permission checks, database updates, autoloader registration, and invoking extension-specific install scripts.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles uninstallation of a Total extension, including permission checks, database updates, and invoking extension-specific uninstall scripts.
